## What does this PR do?

<!-- Add or update events, or change code/docs. One sentence is fine. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New or updated event(s)
- [ ] Code, tooling or CI
- [ ] Documentation only

## Checklist for event changes

- [ ] I opened the organiser's **official page** and the title, dates, location and format match
- [ ] `url` points to the official page; `source_url` (if used) is on the organiser's own site
- [ ] Description is in my own words and 280 characters or fewer
- [ ] Deadlines match the official page, with the correct timezone (`AoE` if unstated)
- [ ] Topics are from `data/topics.yaml`
- [ ] `added` and `last_verified` are set, and `last_verified` is the date I actually checked
- [ ] The event fits [docs/curation-policy.md](../docs/curation-policy.md)
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes

## Checklist for code changes

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run validate` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, schema or commands changed
- [ ] `docs/decisions.md` updated for any deviation or new dependency

## Notes for the reviewer

<!-- Anything unusual: uncertain dates, organiser concerns, links you couldn't verify. -->
